title: 2.11 Big and Small
unit_title: Unit 2: Places, Objects, Numbers, and Colors
unit_outcome: Recognize common surroundings and identify, count, and describe concrete objects without using untaught location language.
lesson_title: Unit 2: Places, Objects, Numbers, and Colors
goal: Describe a known thing as big or small and new or used, and say that two things are the same or different.
grammar_function: It is a + big/small + noun; The + noun + is + new/used; The + plural noun + are + the same/different; size before color (a big red bag).
prerequisite: 1.10 dog; 2.1 it is, house; 2.2 car, bike; 2.3 bag, chair; 2.7 chairs; 2.8 It is a + color + noun; 2.9 bags.
speaking_outcome: Say It is a big dog., The car is new. and The bags are the same. about a picture.
